title: Run Block
description: Run context for an entry that records a human state, reaction, or response. WORK ORDER update pass C5 (superseded 2026-09-09) / §2.3: the human participant was a subject in the experiment, so such entries are observations from a run, not descriptions of a person; the defect is missing run context. Every field the record does not support is the literal string 'unknown', never reconstructed.

run_id.description: Matches the session/log id already in the tree, or 'unknown'.

design.description: What was being varied in that run, or 'unknown'.

measurand.description: What the reaction was recorded AS a measurement of, or 'unknown'. 'unknown' here is itself a finding: the reaction was logged without a declared measurand.
